description: This file implements a class ResponsePollingHandler for managing background response polling with Redis cache, including creation, updating, retrieval, cancelation, and deletion of polling states, following OpenAI response object specifications.

classes.name: ResponsePollingHandler
classes.description: Handles polling-based responses with Redis cache, providing methods to create initial state, update, retrieve, cancel, and delete polling responses.

methods.name: str generate_polling_id(cls)
methods.description: Generates a unique UUID string for polling with a specific prefix.

methods.name: bool is_polling_id(cls, response_id: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a given response ID is a polling ID based on prefix.

methods.name: str get_cache_key(cls, polling_id: str)
methods.description: Constructs a Redis cache key from a polling ID.

methods.name: ResponsesAPIResponse create_initial_state( self, polling_id: str, request_data: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Creates the initial polling state in Redis with status 'queued', timestamp, and associated data following OpenAI response object format.

methods.name: None update_state( self, polling_id: str, status: Optional[ResponsesAPIStatus] = None, usage: Optional[Dict] = None, error: Optional[Dict] = None, incomplete_details: Optional[Dict] = None, reasoning: Optional[Dict] = None, tool_choice: Optional[Any] = None, tools: Optional[list] = None, output: Optional[list] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, instructions: Optional[str] = None, temperature: Optional[float] = None, top_p: Optional[float] = None, max_output_tokens: Optional[int] = None, previous_response_id: Optional[str] = None, text: Optional[Dict] = None, truncation: Optional[str] = None, parallel_tool_calls: Optional[bool] = None, user: Optional[str] = None, store: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Updates the cached polling response state in Redis with new status, output, usage, error, and other response fields.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_state(self, polling_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves current polling state from Redis.

methods.name: bool cancel_polling(self, polling_id: str)
methods.description: Marks a polling request as 'cancelled' in the cache.

methods.name: bool delete_polling(self, polling_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a polling request state from Redis.

methods.name: bool should_use_polling_for_request( background_mode: bool, polling_via_cache_enabled, redis_cache, model: str, llm_router, )

ctags.name: POLLING_ID_PREFIX
ctags.pattern: /^    POLLING_ID_PREFIX = "litellm_poll_"  # Clear prefix to identify polling IDs$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, redis_cache: Optional[RedisCache] = None, ttl: int = 3600):$/

ctags.pattern: /^    async def cancel_polling(self, polling_id: str) -> bool:$/

ctags.name: create_initial_state
ctags.signature: ( self, polling_id: str, request_data: Dict[str, Any], )

ctags.name: delete_polling
ctags.pattern: /^    async def delete_polling(self, polling_id: str) -> bool:$/

ctags.name: get_state
ctags.pattern: /^    async def get_state(self, polling_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: should_use_polling_for_request
ctags.signature: ( background_mode: bool, polling_via_cache_enabled, redis_cache, model: str, llm_router, )
